collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: During a heavy storm, a family's roof starts leaking badly, and their neighbor has a small but dry hut.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: During a heavy storm, a family's roof starts leaking badly, and their neighbor, (name1), has a small but dry hut.

choices.label: Help Patch the Leak in the Rain.
Offer Space Just for the Children.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Everyone squeezes together, and the night becomes cozy.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The hut is very crowded, but no one complains.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patch holds, and the family stays dry.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patch fails, and the family comes over after all.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The family keeps their things dry until morning.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The mats are not enough, but they help a little.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The children sleep soundly while the adults bail water.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The children refuse to leave their parents, so everyone stays together.
